content.text:
I've gone through all ten screens. Now writing up what I took from them and filling in the form.

Honestly, I didn't really decide. If I had to pick now I'd go for an S&P 500 track at a big name, something like "גמל עוקב מדד S&P500" at מיטב (0.53% fee, 13.89% over 3 years). That's what people at work talk about, and the fee is about the same as everywhere else. I'm unsure about it. The thing that tipped it was simply seeing "S&P" next to a name I know. Before anything else I need to find out which company my pension is actually with.

**How it went:**
- **First screen:** the heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the tab "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים 182". That was the right place, so I stayed. Then I saw "182 מסלולים של 15 חברות", with fees from 0.15% to 2%. 182 is way too many.
- **Then the table:** I scrolled with my thumb through מיטב, מור, הפניקס, אלטשולר שחם, הראל, אנליסט, ילין לפידות, מנורה, מגדל, גלובלנט, אינפיניטי, איילון, סלייס, אקטיון.
  - I only stopped on the big return numbers. "גמל מניות" at מיטב (22.07% / 12.64%) and "מניות" at אינפיניטי (23.03% / 15.81%) caught my eye. But I've never heard of אינפיניטי.
  - Almost every fee is somewhere between 0.4% and 0.6%, so they all look the same to me.
  - By screen 3 or 4 I'd basically had enough. On the bus I would have closed it there.
- **What I skipped:** the filter buttons, the search box and the small text at the bottom. I scrolled past the long tracks with "לא דווח" / "פחות מ־5 שנים".
- **Words I didn't get:** "מט"ח", "ההפקדה" vs "ההחיסכון" (two different fees?), "אשראי ואג"ח", "IRA", "בניהול אישי: כל חוסך מחליט במה להשקיע", "עוד לא דווח", "מבטיח תשואה", "הלכה יהודית".
- **What bothered me:**
  - Some tracks show stocks at 101%, 102% or 103%. How can it be more than 100%?
  - One track has a fee of "−0.21%", a minus fee.
  - The dates disagree. The top says the data is correct to end of September 2026, and an orange box says it hasn't been updated since September 2026. The bottom says "נתונים נכון ל־03.11.2026". I can't tell which is true.
  - Nowhere does the page say which track it recommends.
